wiki.title: Bill Gustoff
wiki.extract: William R. Gustoff (born 1968) is an American politician and attorney who has represented the 40th district in the Iowa House of Representatives since January 2023, which consists of parts of northeast Des Moines in Polk County, including most of Altoona and Saylorville. He is a member of the Republican Party.
